summary: The Qilin ransomware gang breached a standalone legacy ATF system (the CALEA system) holding information on ATF investigations and their targets, stealing about 6.3 GB of data including open criminal case files, phone communication analyses, Cellebrite mobile-device extractions and details on suspects, witnesses and informants, much of it from the Houston Field Division. Qilin listed ATF on its leak site on August 26, 2026 and published the files after a 72-hour ransom countdown expired. ATF said the system was isolated and shut down, did not affect its enterprise network or operations, and DOJ designated it a major incident requiring Congressional notification.
